correctness.rationale: The proof splits even inputs, all large odd inputs, the finite odd bridge, and the exact obstruction. For evens, nine explicit residue identities give Zumkeller-plus-practical representations. For odd N >=716683, exhaustive coverage of 99225 odd residues modulo 198450 produces q+945u <=716683 with q practical and gcd(u,105)=1; the coprime multiplier lemma proves 945(u+210t) Zumkeller for every t>=0. A checker directly verifies every even candidate q up to 716683 against two equivalent exact practical criteria, every needed small odd Zumkeller divisor partition, and the finite bridge; only 20177 is missing from the restricted bridge and 20176+1 supplies it. At 19067, q=1 forces nonabundant 19066, and for every even practical q<19067, z=19067-q fails the necessary paired Zumkeller sigma conditions. The checker was executed at its actual current package path and reproduced all assertions. The infinite claim follows from periodic lifting, not bounded computation.

value.rationale: The largest omitted integer of a natural additive sumset is an exact, motivated invariant: it resolves the quantitative gap of the 2023 qualitative eventual-representability theorem. The certified sharp threshold includes a genuine nonrepresentation witness and a constructive representation of all larger integers. The finite bridge is necessary to establish sharpness, and the modular residue cover supplies an unbounded theorem; neither is an arbitrary slice or a routine restatement of the earlier existence theorem. No general theorem beyond this exact motivated invariant is needed for value.
